journey.title: An operator dispositions a trigger that fired
journey.purpose: The journey this scenario exists to make possible. It was impossible before: nothing evaluated a trigger, so no offer ever reached trigger-met and there was nothing to disposition.

steps.intent: See that a trigger fired and which fact satisfied it, without hunting
Read the offer's declared trigger and its full status history before deciding
Accept the promotion, or decline it with a reason that persists
Confirm the entry has left the board, so the loop visibly closes
